| **AbaQuest 2** |  |
|  ![][image1]  | For this segment, I think that students should be able to tap or drag a marker onto the correct part of the image  (for example, circling or touching the upper bead).  Here’s a visual example: ![][image2] |
|            ![][image3] | The answer rod high light needs to be fixed. The answer rod is the horizontal line that separates the upper bead (red) from the lower beads (grey). I really like that way that the each segment is checked as learned. That’s something I would like to keep.  |
|       ![][image4] | The button language should be made to be more age/ grade appropriate. Like Got It\! Let’s Go\! I’m Ready\! I’m Ready to Go\!  |
| ![][image5] | Should be some big anticipator transition into story mode- as the ‘quest’ component of the experience. Use one of the book images to help students engage ![][image6]![][image7] We don’t want to use the language “worth 5” we want to stay consistent with upper bead, lower bead and answer rod Also here: students should be able to tap or drag a marker onto the correct part of the image   |
| **What’s missing from AbaQuest-2** |  |
|       Transitions from one mode to another should be obvious and full of anticipation. |  |
| Each AbaQuest needs to have: Welcome Pre-test Mini lesson/ practice Image-rich Story (quest) post-test Obvious transition from module to module Image-rich story mode Fully designed junior counter Drag or touch pre/ post-test response Kid-friendly language on buttons  |  |
